turnos.t: Why would a firm take the risk of going abroad?

Five of the most common. New markets, when sales at home stop growing. Lower costs, from cheaper labour, land or materials. And avoiding trade barriers, because producing inside a market avoids import tariffs.
Economies of scale, since larger output lowers average cost. And spreading risk: if visitor numbers fall at Disney's parks in the USA, income from France and China helps protect its profits.
